items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I remember to take that picture. Bedou took that picture.

ctx.x: See, that's the steps. That's the balcony, see? No, that wasn't on the boat. That was in the Temple roof guard. I remember to take that picture. Bedou took that picture. Uh-huh. And we come down on the dance floor, you see?
